tagline.en: A deeper clean for bedding and fabrics.

summary.en: A handheld vacuum designed to remove dust mites from beds, sofas and fabrics. A considerate household gift for health-conscious homes.
summary.zh: 手提除塵蟎吸塵機，專為清除床鋪、梳化及布藝上的塵蟎而設，是注重健康家庭的貼心禮品。

features.en: Handheld design for beds and soft furnishings.
features.zh: 手提設計，適合床鋪及布藝家具。

summary.en: A compact 500W PTC ceramic heater with temperature control and built-in overheat and tip-over protection. Sized for desks, it makes a practical winter gift.
summary.zh: 小巧 500W PTC 陶瓷暖風機，具溫度控制及過熱、傾倒斷電保護，適合放在桌面，是實用的冬季禮品。

features.en: Integrated overheat protection and tip-over cut-off.
features.zh: 內置過熱保護及傾倒斷電保護。

summary.en: A water flosser with four tips, five spray settings and a 600 ml tank. IPX4 water resistance makes it a dependable personal care gift.
summary.zh: 水牙線機配備四支噴頭、五種噴水模式及 600ml 水箱，具 IPX4 防水，是可靠的個人護理禮品。

tagline.en: Fragrance and light, in full bloom.
tagline.zh: 香氣與光影，綻放如煙花。

summary.en: A glass aroma diffuser with a 3D firework light effect that humidifies, scents and sets the mood. Supplied with two essential oils in silver or gold, it suits hotels, spas and premium gift programmes.
summary.zh: 玻璃香薰機配 3D 煙花燈效，兼具加濕、香薰及營造氣氛功能，附兩支香薰精油，備銀色及金色，適合酒店、水療中心及高級禮品計劃。

features.en: Humidifies, diffuses fragrance and creates ambient light.
features.zh: 加濕、香薰及營造氣氛三大功能。

features.en: Automatic shut-off when water runs out, plus timer control.
features.zh: 缺水自動斷電，具時間控制。

features.en: Includes lemongrass and lavender essential oils.
features.zh: 附送檸檬草及薰衣草香薰精油各一支。

value.zh: 香薰精油 × 2（檸檬草、薰衣草）

name.en: Electric Gua Sha Microcurrent Facial Massager
name.zh: 電動刮痧儀・臉部微電流按摩器

tagline.en: A spa ritual, in the palm of your hand.

summary.en: A compact gua sha device combining microcurrent, EMS, gentle warmth and five vibration levels for face and body. A refined beauty gift for wellness and corporate programmes.
summary.zh: 小巧刮痧儀結合微電流、EMS、溫熱及五檔震動，適用於臉部及多個部位，是健康及企業計劃的精緻美容禮品。

features.en: Microcurrent and EMS stimulation for facial care.
features.zh: 微電流及 EMS 肌電刺激，呵護面部肌膚。

features.en: Gentle constant warmth helps muscles relax.
Five vibration levels to pair with different skincare products.
features.zh: 五檔震動調節，配合不同護膚品使用。

features.en: Suitable for multiple areas of the face and body.
Lightweight 61 g body with USB charging.
